No tracked files were modified — only new files added. Let me write HANDOFF.md and do a final full verification run.

{"action":"shell","command":"cat > /testbed/HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'\n# tinydb milestone 1 - handoff\n\n## What was built\n- `tinydb/journal.py` with `BatchWriter(db)` wrapping a TinyDB instance;
  uses only the default table (`db.default_table_name`).
- `apply(operations)`:
  - ops: `{'op':'insert','document':dict}` -> returns new doc id;
    `{'op':'remove','doc_id':positive int}` -> no result.
  - returns list of inserted ids; empty input -> [].
  - unknown/malformed ops (non-dict op, unknown op name, missing/invalid
    keys, non-positive/non-int doc_id, bool doc_id, non-list operations)
    -> ValueError, no state change.
- Atomicity (R02): whole batch validated up front; applied sequentially
  via the table's own `_get_next_id`/`_update_table`; on ANY error the
  pre-batch default-table data is restored by rewriting the storage
  (other tables preserved), `table._next_id` restored, and
  `table.clear_cache()` called so previously acquired handles reflect
  both success and rollback.
- R03: documents deep-copied on insert (no aliasing either direction);
  ordinary TinyDB APIs untouched.

## Notes / design decisions
- Rollback restores the default table only (not the whole DB) so other
  tables are untouched.
- A failed batch does not consume document IDs (next_id restored).
- Inserting a `Document` instance is accepted (it is a Mapping) and stored
  under a fresh auto id, like `Table.insert` for plain dicts.
- Storage write on rollback uses `{}` (not None) for empty DBs since
  storages may not accept None.

## Tests
- `tests/test_journal.py` (64 tests, memory + JSON storages): R01/R02/R03,
  stale query cache, other-table isolation, id-sequence restore, aliasing.
- Verified: `acceptance_public.py` (2 passed), full `tests/` (287 passed),
  CachingMiddleware scenario, JSON file storage round trip.
- Upstream tests unchanged (git status: only new files added).

## Run
    python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q -o addopts=\nEOF\ncd /testbed && python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q -o addopts= 2>&1 | tail -5"}
